Title: Subscription Order — Open Subscription
Preconditions:
Admin logged in to Backend
Subscription feature enabled
Customer with active subscription exists
Steps:
1. Navigate to ${BACK_URL}/orders
2. Locate and open a subscription order (identified by subscription icon/badge)
3. Verify the Subscription widget is visible on the order details blade
4. Open the Subscription widget to view subscription details
5. Verify subscription fields: frequency, next order date, status
6. Attempt to modify subscription frequency
7. Save changes and verify persistence
8. Verify related orders are linked in the subscription chain

6. Open the Configuration tab and verify all selected options are displayed
7. Verify Discounts tab shows any configuration-related discounts
8. Verify Dynamic Properties tab is accessible

Title: Role-Based Order Access — Operator Can Only View Assigned Orders
Preconditions:
Admin logged in to Backend
Order Manager role created with order permissions [ORDA-031]
Employee1 assigned to Order Manager role
Order1 assigned to Employee1
Order2 assigned to a different employee
Steps:
1. Login to ${BACK_URL} as Employee1 with Order Manager role
2. Navigate to Orders module
3. Verify Orders blade link is visible
4. Open Orders list and note which orders are displayed
5. Verify Order1 (assigned to Employee1) is visible
6. Verify Order2 (assigned to another employee) is NOT visible
7. Attempt to directly access Order2 via URL
8. Verify access is restricted
